title: Takeaways from a big primary night in Michigan, Kansas, Missouri and more
description: The Michigan Senate race remained too close to call, but Democratic ideological battles ended in mixed results in House primaries.

title: House Ethics Committee opens investigation into Ohio Republican Max Miller
description: The House Ethics Committee has opened an investigation into Rep. Max Miller, after the Ohio Republican asked for a probe of the domestic abuse allegations that have swirled around his reelection bid.

title: Despite financial advantages, Republican Party faces major challenge in midterm
description: Republicans face political headwinds in this fall's midterm elections. The party also maintains structural advantages that could help them preserve their majorities in Congress.

title: Judge dismisses Jan. 6 seditious conspiracy charges against Oath Keepers
description: While taking the last step in the legal process to wipe out penalties from the riot, the judge also criticized the Justice Department for undoing the most serious convictions.

title: Democrat exits Senate race in South Dakota, clearing way for independent
description: Julian Beaudion withdrew after resisting pressure to step aside, making South Dakota’s contest the third Senate race without a Democratic candidate.

title: Authorities arrested a man with ammo and apparently monitoring security at Trump golf course near LA
description: The Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department said Jeanine John Taele, 38, was taking photos and video and had a 16-round magazine with ammunition in his pocket.

title: Who’s winning in California v. Trump lawsuits so far?
description: The White House calls California’s suits ‘frivolous’ amid court battles.

title: TMZ trades Hollywood gossip for Capitol Hill scoops with new D.C. bureau
description: Over the past 20 years, TMZ has made a name for itself with big scoops on celebrity culture. Now, the popular gossip and news site is taking on Capitol Hill.

title: House Ethics Committee will investigate Ohio Republican Max Miller
description: The committee said it was reviewing allegations that Miller "may have engaged in domestic violence." Miller has denied the allegations, which have swirled around his bid for a third term in Congress.

title: Senate Democrats say banks turned blind eye to suspicious moves by Jeffrey Epstein
description: A report from Senate Democrats accuses big banks of failing to report suspicious money transfers made by Jeffrey Epstein until after his arrest in 2019.

title: Here’s what to watch for in Tuesday’s primaries
description: After a few weeks of relative calm on the midterms calendar, we’ve got a slate of states with important primaries across the country today.

title: Trump keeps making threats. The world has stopped flinching.
description: The president’s bombast has ceased to rattle world leaders, who have seen him fenced in by courts, rebuffed by Congress and strung along by Iran.

title: 5 states hold primaries today. And, Spokane police arrest man connected to wildfire
description: Five state primaries are being held today, and Michigan is a key focus for Democrats who want to see how progressives fare in races. And, a man has been arrested in connection with a Spokane fire.

title: Senate Judiciary Committee to vote on Todd Blanche's nomination for attorney general
description: The Senate Judiciary Committee is expected to vote Tuesday on Todd Blanche's nomination for attorney general after Blanche assuaged concerns from two Republican senators.

title: Sen. Alex Padilla, D-Calif., on expected vote to advance Todd Blanche's nomination
description: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks with Sen. Alex Padilla, D-Calif., about the Senate Judiciary Committee's anticipated vote on Todd Blanche's nomination for attorney general.

title: 5 states have primary elections on Tuesday. These are the races to watch
description: From Michigan's Senate and governor primary to Missouri's 1st Congressional District, a number of key races in primary elections Tuesday could signal the future for Democrats and Republicans.

title: Why Trump is lashing out at Chevron amid profit windfall
description: The president criticized Chevron for not giving the administration what he considers adequate credit for the oil major’s financial success.
